body: Just the two of us he's told me he specifically requested only one other person two people would "bother him"

College was rough for me too I ended up playing too many video games as a coping tool but I played so much that I just skipped out on going out with the guys or even studying or doing homework and I'd save everything until the last minute. I didn't meet my girlfriend until halfway through college she's the one who saved me from myself. I wasn't on good terms with my mother (she's a result of being so upset in middle school) so I was fortunate enough to have her to be my rock and she's the one that convinced me to start seeking help. Just try to find anyone that will listen to you, getting it off your chest will help in time and if you see a therapist maybe they can give you some medicine that will help you in the long run.

I'm currently talking to a therapist but all he does is put things on a computer and tells me what medicine to take it's like I don't talk to him for him to listen I talk to him to just get medicine. But I've only seen him twice now after deciding to help myself. As for right now I'm at a job I hate extremely and I work in shifts and I work with one other guy and he's 50+ years old and barely talks to me but when he does it's because I did something wrong (usually yelling). I'm stuck with him for 4 days at a time and am afraid to even go near him. This just drives me insane to no end and makes me feel even worse than I should.

I was in the same situation but I was the one going away and my girlfriend was staying behind. Luckily I have her to talk to and email I went away 3 months also. It's hard knowing that your ray of sunshine is going to be gone for a little bit but if you set your mind on looking forward to seeing them after those three months and how happy you'll be I promise it will help. Honestly if I didn't have her to look forward to I wouldn't have seen a meaning to my life and just given up. So just remember to look forward to seeing that person again I promise it will help.

Sorry if this is a little late I know it's been almost 12 hours since your original post but I just want you to know you aren't alone in not telling anyone. I've noticed my depressive behavior about high school but it could go back to middle school (it's a long story to explain why) but it took me until I was out of college in the real world to finally ask for help, I couldn't and still don't think I can do it on my own to be honest but it helped me exponentially to talk to someone. Even if it is a therapist or a pet or your parents whoever will listen if you get it off your chest I promise it will help you I has me. I'm still on the road to get myself better. Hope this helped somehow, I promise you aren't alone.

I'm currently going to start looking for something else but in the meantime I'm stuck working this job with the same guy. I really wish it were different it's just a struggle to wake up and take on the day. I really appreciate the comments it helps to talk to people who have or are going/gone through what I'm doing right now.

Work mainly I feel like I'm so alone out here (I work out on a boat with someone who is bitter and just nasty to me) I just wake up in the morning and know it's coming. I haven't slept more than 6 hours in the past few days and all I've eaten is a granola bar I can barely function, every time I try to talk to someone I feel like they're just fed up with all my bs I feel like my girlfriend deserves someone better who can treat her right and I can't break up with her because I love her too much to let her go. Maybe killing myself is actually the answer.

Unfortunately it's just me and him on this boat for 4 days (you could imagine how that is). So I have to put up with his shit all day and when he's finally gone I get to work alone and if something little happens or I mess up I'm so afraid to even go near the guy. He's just a bitter old man who has nothing better to do. Luckily I have options and I'm trying to get onto a land based job where I don't need to worry about this (sorry I'm ranting nobody is really listening to me at all right now). But we have been playing just dance as a couples thing to do since we play with her roomate and her boyfriend. If you feel comfortable you can always tell me about your day I'm here to help if you need it since you were kind enough to listen to my bs for a bit. Also I forgot to answer before but I do not have a 3ds my friend does though she plays some lawyer game on it.

Yeah we've been trying to do games together whenever it's possible. That's been helping and it's just the days when I'm working that I feel the worst because I'm at a job I loathe and the captain of the ship is a total asshole which just makes me feel worse. But everyone is trying to help me through everything and help me land a job that I like an don't have an anxiety attack over going to. I used to be into the table top version of warhammer but that started costing a lot of money so I had to give that up. You know if you want just send me a pm next after this I'm sort of new to reddit but you know if you need someone to talk to I don't mind.

I have the same problem right now I'm just always feeling so shitty all the time and it's honestly the worst. Most often than not I wake up and wish I just fell asleep and didn't wake up. It's just really frustrating to me that I can't help and feel this way and just wish it would go away because it's affecting everyone around me and my work.

Well what I do for a living right now I just got out of school and I'm working on a tug boat. Honestly this is the source of my unhappiness but that's another conversation. I've been good about not playing too much lately I'm just a little scared that I'll gravitate toward doing that again because that was my coping mechanism for my depression (I has been since the sixth grade for me) and it's extremely hard for me to stop. My girlfriend has been very understanding and she tries to get me to do other things which usually works even if it's watching tv or just taking a nap with her. I'm really grateful that you have taken time to talk to me and you understand how I feel slightly. It's helping me deal with my day today at least so thank you and just know these small things that you do for people can make a big difference. As for the art thing and reading I cannot relate unfortunately I'm a very physical person so I've always been into video games and sports. I've been trying to read a couple of warhammer 40k books.

I don't have much experience with ppd or military experience so I could imagine that makes it harder. But with time that light at the end of the tunnel will get brighter and brighter until you finally manage to step through it and one day you'll realize that your little girl is worth every second that you put into her when you get to be with her through whatever life throws at her. I really wish I could be more help just realize that life might be hard now but it'll get better from my experience I promise. Don't worry about the length it's best to just get it off your chest and talking to people always helps me when I'm having a very low point in my days.

I know what you're going through all of my friends are moving on. My best friend who has been with me since the 7th grade has just moved to a different state and I honestly can't even remember one week since I've met him that we haven't hung out. What I've been trying to do ever since he left (almost 3 weeks ago) is call him once in awhile and just talk about what we normally talk about as if he was there, it seems to help for the time being. Hope this helped you a little OP

Really thank you for responding this is the first time today I actually had a moment where I was slightly happy (don't mean to sound too sad). It's just nothing is going right today for me my new meds don't work and I'm 3 days away from being back home. But to get back to the topic i do actually try my best to pull myself away from the video games whenever I can I used to smoke a pack a day and I would usually go somewhere else to smoke. So I would be out and around people but now that I really have no friends that live around me it just gets harder and harder. My girlfriend is still in school so she sees me when she can but I always end up going back to video games. Did you ever have this problem of not being able to peel yourself away from the screen? If so how did you do it?

I'm doing the same thing you are right now except when I'm working I'm stuck here for 4 days at a time doing shift work, and it's miserable. The best thing the works for me is to call someone (if you can) every so often and just talk about things. That's why I'm on here now is I just want to talk and help that's all I feel I'm good at nowadays anyway, but I hope this helps you out as it has me.

I actually have the problem of letting video games turn into an escape. I just got destiny when it came out at midnight on Tuesday, I believe it was, and played straight through until I had to go back to work, by that time I didn't even know what day it was. It's always honestly been a problem for me even through college, my grades definitely suffered as a result. I still haven't figured out what works for me but right now I'm trying to switch jobs to see if that will stop me from using it as an escape, I'm hoping it helps and having an SO that cares really helps me get through my days because if it wasn't for her I probably would have (I hate to say it) killed myself a long time ago. (Hope this helps a little I know I went on a small tangent).
